sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

[MISSING_CARDINALITY] gen:IMO_097_ShipShape / true branch / hasRequiredRescueBoatOrLifeboat: The true applicability branch has no sh:minCount on hasRequiredRescueBoatOrLifeboat, so a ship operating in low air temperature can satisfy the branch without any released rescue boat or lifeboat being represented or checked. Required change: Require at least one applicable released rescue boat or lifeboat and apply the required device constraints to every such value. | [APPLICABILITY] gen:IMO_097_ShipShape / true branch / hasSurvivalCraft and hasRequiredRescueBoatOrLifeboat: The candidate does not encode the requirement's released-craft scope: it neither requires nor filters the rescue boats and lifeboats that are released for evacuation. The unconstrained hasSurvivalCraft property also does not establish that its values are the released rescue boats and lifeboats covered by the clause. Required change: Constrain the applicable released rescue boat and lifeboat values directly, and enforce all three device minimums for every value in that set. | [COMPLETENESS] gen:IMO_097_RequiredLifeboatShape: The required-lifeboat shape checks only hasDistressAlertDevice and omits the mandatory location-signal device and on-scene transmit/receive communication device requirements for each applicable rescue boat or lifeboat. Required change: Add minimum-one constraints for the location-signal device and on-scene transmit/receive communication device on every applicable rescue boat or lifeboat. | [OWNERSHIP_OR_PATH] gen:IMO_097_ShipShape / true branch / hasSurvivalCraft: The three device constraints are attached to hasSurvivalCraft values rather than being unambiguously attached to every released rescue boat and lifeboat required by the clause; this can miss covered craft or constrain unrelated survival-craft values. Required change: Use the applicable released rescue boat-or-lifeboat path as the constrained node set, or otherwise explicitly relate that set to the device-bearing nodes without changing the requirement's scope.

[LOGIC] gen:IMO_097_ShipShape/sh:or true branch: When low-air-temperature operation is true, the candidate requires only one value of hasRequiredRescueBoatOrLifeboat and validates only that selected value; it does not require the device conditions for every applicable released rescue boat and lifeboat. Required change: Apply the three minimum-count device constraints universally to every applicable released rescue boat and lifeboat rather than to a single minimum-count selected value. | [APPLICABILITY] gen:IMO_097_ShipShape/sh:or true branch: The true branch has no condition identifying whether each rescue boat or lifeboat is released, so the required device checks are not scoped to the requirement's released-craft applicability. Required change: Add an executable released-craft applicability condition for each rescue boat or lifeboat covered by the universal requirement. | [LOGIC] gen:IMO_097_RequiredLifeboatShape: The shape is restricted by sh:class nltl:lifeboat and is applied only through hasRequiredRescueBoatOrLifeboat, so rescue boats are excluded from the three mandatory device checks. Required change: Cover both rescue boats and lifeboats in the applicable-craft constraint, without restricting validation to lifeboat instances only. | [OMITTED_SEMANTIC_ELEMENT] gen:IMO_097_ShipShape/sh:or true branch and gen:IMO_097_SurvivalCraftShape: The candidate declares hasSurvivalCraft but does not attach gen:IMO_097_SurvivalCraftShape with sh:node, so the survival-craft device constraints are never enforced; the required relationship to the per-craft checks is therefore missing. Required change: Attach the applicable survival-craft shape to the relevant craft path and ensure the attached shape uses the required distress-alert, location-signal, and on-scene communication paths.
